description: This file defines a PHP class for handling Microsoft Access database connectivity via ADO (ActiveX Data Objects) for the ADODB library. It includes driver-specific settings and methods to manage transactions for Access databases, and subclasses for recordset handling.

classes.name: ADODB_ado_access
classes.description: Driver class for Microsoft Access using ADO, extending ADODB_ado to provide Access-specific configuration and transaction handling.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado_access
classes.description: Class for Access-specific recordset handling, extending ADORecordSet_ado.

methods.name: ADODB_ado_access
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Access driver class.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Overrides transaction initiation, returns false indicating no transaction support.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Overrides transaction commit, returns false indicating no support.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Overrides transaction rollback, returns false indicating no support.

methods.name: ADORecordSet_ado_access
methods.description: Constructor for Access-specific recordset, extending ADORecordSet_ado.
